metadata.design_notes: Original 16x12 structure retained at (2,30); existing artifacts restaged in the front court. Raw zeros retained with explicit support covers after relocation. Museum side aisle stays outside generated geometry. Old raised cells are witnesses, not a promised accessible deck. Four added circulation rows separate the retained rear structure from the perimeter wall geometry.
